text: FIX the schema migration ran twice with `multiInstance: false` when `startMigration()` or `migratePromise()` were called more than once before the first call had started the migration, for example `startMigration()` followed by `migratePromise()` in the same tick. The migration strategies ran twice for each document, the migration status reported more handled documents than the total, and the memory storage threw an unhandled `removed already` rejection. These calls now share one migration run
